set.body: Epic: bd-01KWVZPNECAPJ19KD7HDD8ERRA. Implement Morphism, MorphismKind, Inverse, RouteTag, MorphismPath, and immutable SpatialGraph routing. Acceptance: small Dijkstra over typed edges, route tags for shortest/anatomical/functional, reverse routing only for exact/provided/approximate inverses, adjoint-only never treated as geometric inverse, no public graph-library dependency, and JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Spatial graph: immutable morphism routing and inverse policy
